dedupe_keys.name: electrical load profile from an eletrocplating company

description: Tjarko Tjaden at Hochschule Emden/Leer publishes measured electricity-load profiles from an electroplating company in Germany's 734xx postal-code area. Two CSV files cover 2017 and part of 2018. The measurements were released through PIEG-Strom, a project investigating electrical storage in building energy systems and developing an open-source building-energy simulation tool. Zenodo provides the April 2021 deposit free under CC BY 4.0. The page does not identify the company, meter rating, precise start and end dates or sampling interval; these details remain unknown until the file documentation is inspected. The observations can supply an industrial demand profile for storage-sizing or capacity-planning experiments. A single facility should not be treated as representative of the entire electroplating industry. No files were downloaded, and no related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
